description.pt: Rede colaborativa de cultura e eventos que une DJs, produtores e espaços em uma plataforma viva com foco em apoio mútuo, inovação e leveza. Atuo com planejamento, coordenação multidisciplinar e melhoria contínua de processos, e desenvolvo o plugin WordPress do projeto.
description.en: A collaborative culture-and-events network connecting DJs, producers and venues in a living platform focused on mutual support, innovation and lightness. I contribute planning, multidisciplinary coordination and continuous process improvement, and develop the project's WordPress plugin.

cv_framing_2026_11.title: Founder & Digital Product Developer - apollo::rio (Nov 2024-Present)
cv_framing_2026_11.body_en: Designed and developed an independent digital platform for Rio de Janeiro's cultural and creative ecosystem. Own the product roadmap and delivery across UX/UI, web architecture, WordPress-based services, APIs, structured data, automation, user flows, access roles, documentation and continuous improvement.

workstation_evidence.observed: D:\dev contém _apollo.rio.br, _library apollo, backup LocalWP e ~30 lotes de sincronização de plugins Apollo (core, events, login, push, maps, SEO, social, statistics, templates, journal-news, hub, event importer, Elementor/Elementor Pro, co-author, MU-plugin, DJ interface).
